description.en: Short, clean extraction of a Brazilian bean: cocoa, nut, caramel, medium body. Calmer than espresso, denser than V60. A bridge with a medium Connecticut or Habano; nothing shouts on either side.
description.hr: Kratka, čista ekstrakcija brazilskog zrna: kakao, orah, karamela, srednje tijelo. Mirniji od espressa, gušći od V60. Most uz srednju Connecticut ili Habano cigaru; nema što vrišti ni s jedne strane.

description.en: Espresso diluted with hot water: medium TDS, softer entry, easier to pace with smoke. Crema in the water can sit bitter; skimmed crema gives a cleaner cup. Versatile with medium cigars, without a doppio's weight.
description.hr: Espresso razrijeđen vrućom vodom: srednji TDS, blaži ulaz, lakše ritmirati s dimom. Crema u vodi zna gorko sjesti; skinuta crema daje čišću šalicu. Svestran uz srednje cigare, bez težine doppia.

description.en: Office or bar dark filter coffee, larger volume. Cocoa, smoke, bitterness, low acidity. A reliable, unexciting bridge with a medium cigar. Not specialty; it works while hot and not stewed.
description.hr: Uredska ili barske tamna filter kava, veći volumen. Kakao, dim, gorčina, niska kiselost. Pouzdan, neuzbudljiv most uz srednju cigaru. Nije specialty; radi dok je vruća i nije prekuhana.

description.en: Cerrado or Santos, often natural: low acidity, cocoa, hazelnut, caramel. The default coffee with most cigars because nothing shouts. Maduro and Habano sit calmly; a floral Connecticut loses a little sparkle but still works.
description.hr: Cerrado ili Santos, često natural: niska kiselost, kakao, lješnjak, karamela. To je zadana kava uz većinu cigara jer ništa ne vrišti. Maduro i Habano sjede mirno; cvjetni Connecticut gubi malo sjaja, ali prolazi.

description.en: Washed Kayanza: currant, red apple, juicy acidity, light body. A fresh contrast with Cameroon or a shorter Habano. A Geisha-thin cigar works; a full Nicaraguan overruns the fruit in one puff.
description.hr: Oprani Kayanza: ribiz, crvena jabuka, sočna kiselost, lagano tijelo. Svjež kontrast uz Cameroon ili kraći Habano. Geisha-tanka cigara radi; puna nikaragvanska pregazi voće u jednom dimu.

description.en: Espresso plus milk and foam. Milk softens pepper and nicotine, but covers floral and mineral notes. A morning match with Connecticut or a mild natural; Habano still passes, maduro disappears in the foam.
description.hr: Espresso plus mlijeko i pjena. Mlijeko omekšava papar i nikotin, ali pokriva cvjetne i mineralne note. Jutarnji spoj uz Connecticut ili blagi natural; Habano još prolazi, maduro se gubi u pjeni.

description.en: Espresso 'corrected' with spirit (Licor 43, brandy or rum). A Mediterranean mess that works when the sip is small. Medium to full cigar; a sweet liqueur with Shade turns the smoke into dessert without structure.
description.hr: Espresso 'popravljen' žesticom (Licor 43, brandy ili rum). Mediteranski nered koji radi kad je gutljaj mali. Srednja do puna cigara; slatki liker uz Shade pretvara dim u desert bez strukture.

description.en: Cold extraction 12–24 hours: low acidity, chocolate smoothness, medium body. A summer terrace with a medium cigar. Ice must not melt the cup to water; density has to stay, or the smoke is left alone.
description.hr: Hladna ekstrakcija 12–24 sata: niska kiselost, čokoladna glatkoća, srednje tijelo. Ljetna terasa uz srednju cigaru. Led ne smije rastopiti šalicu do vode; gustoća mora ostati, inače dim ostaje sam.

description.en: Huila, washed, medium roast: caramel, red apple, nut. The most versatile filter coffee in the catalogue. It follows a medium Habano without a fight; neither too light for Connecticut nor too weak for a moderate maduro.
description.hr: Huila, oprana, srednje prženje: karamela, crvena jabuka, orah. Najsvestranija filtar kava u katalogu. Prati srednje Habano cigare bez borbe; ni prelagana za Connecticut ni preslaba za umjereni maduro.

description.en: Equal parts espresso and warm milk, little foam. Bitterness eases, cocoa stays. Afternoon with a mild to medium cigar; it hides less than a cappuccino and hits less than straight espresso.
description.hr: Jednaki dijelovi espressa i toplo mlijeko, bez velike pjene. Gorčina se skine, kakao ostaje. Poslijepodne uz blagu do srednju cigaru; manje skriva note od cappuccina, manje udara od čistog espressa.

description.en: Sierra Maestra, darker roast: cocoa, tobacco, caramel, low acidity. The terroir match with a Cuban cigar is logic, not magic. Sweet cafecito is the local pace; unsweetened it stays a drier bridge.
description.hr: Sierra Maestra, tamnije prženje: kakao, duhan, karamela, niska kiselost. Teritorijalni spoj uz kubansku cigaru drži se logike, ne magije. Cafecito sa šećerom je lokalni ritam; bez šećera ostaje suši most.

description.en: Espresso with demerara beaten into the crema: bitterness and sugar in the same cup. A Cuban habit with a short, earthy cigar. Sugar glues a maduro's final third; Connecticut becomes candy.
description.hr: Espresso u kojem se demerara ubije u cremu: gorčina i šećer u istoj šalici. Kubanska navika uz kratku, zemljanu cigaru. Šećer lijepi zadnju trećinu madura; Connecticut postaje bombon.

description.en: Colombian EA / sugarcane decaf, medium roast. Caffeine is gone; caramel and cocoa stay readable enough. An evening cigar when you do not want a second espresso; pairing follows body, not caffeine.
description.hr: Kolumbijski EA / sugarcane decaf, srednje prženje. Kofein je skinut, karamela i kakao ostaju dovoljno čitki. Večernja cigara kad ne želiš drugi espresso; sparivanje prati tijelo, ne kofein.

description.en: Two espressos in one cup: volume and caffeine for a long session. Bitterness and cocoa keep pace through the cigar's final third. Lounge standard with a full Habano or maduro.
description.hr: Dva espressa u jednoj šalici: volumen i kofein za dugu sesiju. Gorčina i kakao drže ritam kroz zadnju trećinu cigare. Standard u cigar loungeu uz punu Habano ili maduro cigaru.

description.en: Specialty espresso from 100% arabica, medium roast. Sweeter and fruitier than a bar blend, with less bitter aftertaste. It suits medium Habano and Cameroon; maduro easily overruns it.
description.hr: Specialty espresso od 100 % arabice, srednje pržen. Slađi je i voćniji od barske mješavine, s manje gorčine u aftertasteu. Ide uz srednje Habano i Cameroon cigare; maduro ga lako pregazi.

description.en: Espresso with 10–15 ml VSOP cognac in the same cup. Cocoa, oak and caramel from both parts. A double bridge with a medium to full cigar after a meal; a morning Connecticut has no business here.
description.hr: Espresso s 10–15 ml VSOP konjaka u istoj šalici. Kakao, hrast i karamela iz oba sastojka. Dvostruki most uz srednju do punu cigaru nakon jela; jutarnji Connecticut ovdje nema što tražiti.

description.en: Classic bar espresso with robusta: dense, bitter, thick crema. Dark roast drops fruit acidity and leaves cocoa, ash and earth. It carries maduro and a full Habano; a mild Connecticut sits under the cup.
description.hr: Klasični bar espresso s udjelom robuste: gust, gorak, s debelom cremom. Tamno prženje gubi voćnu kiselost i ostavlja kakao, pepeo i zemlju. Nosi maduro i punu Habano cigaru; blagi Connecticut ostaje ispod šalice.

description.en: Espresso marked with a dash of milk: the cup's power stays, bitterness eases a little. A compromise between straight espresso and cappuccino. A medium to full cigar still keeps pace; a floral filter has no business here.
description.hr: Espresso označen kapi mlijeka: snaga šalice ostaje, gorčina se malo skine. Kompromis između čistog espressa i cappuccina. Srednja do puna cigara i dalje drži ritam; cvjetni filter ovdje nema smisla.

description.en: Sidamo or Guji, dried in cherry: blueberry, wine, flower, more body than washed Yirgacheffe. A fruit contrast with a spicy short Habano. A full maduro turns the fruit to jam and loses cleanliness.
description.hr: Sidamo ili Guji, sušena trešnja: borovnica, vino, cvijet, više tijela nego oprana Yirgacheffe. Voćni kontrast uz začinski Habano kratkog formata. Puna maduro cigara pretvara voće u džem i gubi čistoću.

description.en: Doppio under a thin microfoam: more coffee than a cappuccino, less milk than a latte. A creamy bridge with Connecticut or a mild natural. Maduro still sees the milk as a curtain.
description.hr: Doppio pod tankom mikro-pjenom: više kave nego cappuccino, manje mlijeka nego latte. Kremasti most uz Connecticut ili blagi natural. Maduro i dalje vidi mlijeko kao zavjesu.

description.en: Franck’s food-service espresso beans: South America and Asia, intensity 8.5 of 10. The house highlights dark chocolate and a rich, lasting crema. It is not the supermarket Ciglica — it belongs on a machine, 25–30 ml. It sits with a full Habano or maduro, not Shade.
description.hr: Franckov ugostiteljski espresso u zrnu: Južna Amerika i Azija, intenzitet 8,5 od 10. Kuća ističe tamnu čokoladu i bogatu, postojanu pjenu. Nije supermarketska Ciglica — ide na aparat, 25–30 ml. Uz nju sjeda puna Habano ili maduro cigara, ne Shade.

description.en: Franck Crema is finest-ground Turkish coffee: rich foam and creamy chocolate and cocoa notes. Brew it in a cezve or pour over with hot water. It is not the 3-in-1 with milk and sugar — that is a different SKU. Straight Crema wants a medium Habano; sweetened in the pot it can carry maduro.
description.hr: Franck Crema je najfinije mljevena turska kava: bogata pjena i kremaste note čokolade i kakaovca. Kuha se u džezvi ili se prelije vrućom vodom. Nije 3-u-1 s mlijekom i šećerom — to je drugi proizvod. Uz čistu Cremu ide srednja Habano cigara; zaslađena u loncu podnosi i maduro.

description.en: Franck’s vacuum-packed espresso for a home machine: silky texture, crema, caramel, hazelnut and mild fruit. The house presents it for the whole day, not only a morning shot. It suits a medium Habano while the cup is hot.
description.hr: Franckov vakuumirani espresso za kućni aparat: svilenkasta tekstura, crema, karamela, lješnjak i blago voće. Kuća ga drži za cijeli dan, ne samo za jutarnji shot. Ide uz srednju Habano cigaru dok je šalica vruća.

description.en: Zagreb’s Ciglica: Franck blends arabica and robusta from Central and South America and Asia. The house calls it the queen for a full chocolate flavour. It is made in a cezve — two spoons per 100 ml, heated to foam, then left three to five minutes. Dense and familiar; it sits with a medium-to-full cocoa cigar, not Shade.
description.hr: Zagrebačka Ciglica: Franck miješa arabicu i robustu iz Srednje i Južne Amerike i Azije. Kuća je zove kraljicom zbog punog čokoladnog okusa. Kuha se u džezvi — dvije žličice na sto mililitara, do pjene, pa tri do pet minuta stajanja. Gusta je i poznata; uz nju sjeda srednja do puna cigara s kakaom, ne Shade.

description.en: Franck’s Ciglica in a darker cut: arabica and robusta from Central and South America, Africa and Asia. The house cites dark chocolate and sweet spices, intensity 4.5 of 5. Brewed in a cezve like Original. Dense and morning-like; it wants a full Habano or maduro, not Shade.
description.hr: Franckova Ciglica u tamnijem ruhu: arabica i robusta iz Srednje i Južne Amerike, Afrike i Azije. Kuća navodi tamnu čokoladu i slatke začine, intenzitet 4,5 od 5. Kuha se u džezvi kao Original. Gusta je i jutarnja; uz nju ide puna Habano ili maduro cigara, ne Shade.

description.en: The softer sister of Original: arabica and robusta, a velvety cup, milk chocolate and hazelnut. Franck rates it 3.5 of 5. It is not a 3-in-1 with milk — the chocolate is in the bean. Brewed in a cezve. It keeps a medium Habano; maduro is too heavy.
description.hr: Mekša sestra Originala: arabica i robusta, baršunast okus, mliječna čokolada i lješnjak. Franck joj daje intenzitet 3,5 od 5. Nije 3-u-1 s mlijekom — čokolada je u zrnu. Kuha se u džezvi. Uz nju ostaje srednja Habano cigara; maduro je pretežak.

description.en: Dark blend, four minutes in the press, sediment in the cup. Full texture, cocoa and earth, low acidity. A long cup for a long cigar; the pace is slower than espresso, so smoke and sip trade places more easily.
description.hr: Tamna mješavina, četiri minute u preši, talog u šalici. Puna tekstura, kakao i zemlja, niska kiselost. Duga šalica za dugu cigaru; ritam je sporiji nego kod espressa, pa se dim i gutljaj lakše izmjenjuju.

description.en: Volcanic Antigua: cocoa, spice, a whiff of smoke at medium body. Washed process keeps it clean; altitude densifies the bean. It likes a Habano wrapper; Connecticut is too mild, oscuro too heavy.
description.hr: Vulkanski Antigua: kakao, začin, dašak dima uz srednje tijelo. Oprana obrada drži čistoću, a visina daje gustoću zrna. Voli Habano pokrov; Connecticut je preblag, oscuro pretežak.

description.en: illy Classico is the same 100% arabica blend (nine origins), medium roast. The house cites a smooth, velvety cup with caramel, orange blossom and jasmine and a sweet aftertaste. It lacks bar-robusta bitterness. It keeps a medium Habano or Cameroon; maduro is too heavy.
description.hr: illy Classico je ista 100 % arabica mješavina (devet podrijetla), srednje pržena. Kuća navodi gladak, baršunast okus s karamelom, narančinim cvijetom i jasminom te slatkast aftertaste. Nema gorčine barske robuste. Uz nju ostaje srednja Habano ili Cameroon cigara; maduro je pretežak.

description.en: The same illy 100% arabica, roasted longer to the dark Intenso profile. Official: aromatic cup, cocoa and dried fruit, full aftertaste. No robusta, so bitterness comes from roast, not species. It carries a fuller Habano and maduro better than Classico.
description.hr: Ista illyeva 100 % arabica, dulje pržena do tamnog profila Intenso. Službeno: aromatičan okus, kakao i suho voće, pun aftertaste. Nema robuste, pa gorčina dolazi od prženja, ne od vrste. Nosi puniju Habano i maduro cigaru bolje nego Classico.

description.en: Sugar and milk powder blanket both the bean and the cigar — fine notes vanish and only sweetness remains. With a mild cigar it drowns everything worth tasting; if it is all you have, drink water alongside the smoke instead.
description.hr: Šećer i mliječni prah prekrivaju i zrno i cigaru — fine note nestanu, ostaje slatkoća. Uz blagu cigaru guši sve što bi se imalo osjetiti; ako je to jedino pri ruci, radije popij vodu uz dim.

description.en: Dried extract, mostly robusta: flat bitterness without fresh-coffee aroma. With a cigar it works as a warm neutral base — it lifts nothing, but does not fight a milder smoke either. When the choice is instant or nothing, take less sugar and more water.
description.hr: Sušeni ekstrakt, uglavnom robusta: ravna gorčina bez arome svježe kave. Uz cigaru radi kao topla neutralna podloga — ne pojačava ništa, ali ni ne smeta blažem dimu. Kad je izbor između instanta i ničega, uzmi manje šećera i više vode.

description.en: Hot coffee, Irish whiskey, sugar and cream. Two bridges in one glass: roast and spirit. It wants a medium cigar after a meal; Connecticut sinks, and the strongest maduro turns the sweetness to glue.
description.hr: Topla kava, irski viski, šećer i šlag. Dva mosta u jednoj čaši: prženje i žestica. Traži srednju cigaru poslije jela; Connecticut utone, a najjači maduro pretvara slatkoću u ljepilo.

description.en: Smooth, honeyed, low bitterness; washed, medium roast. It is expensive because it is zoned and scarce, not because it is 'best with a cigar'. A special-occasion cup with an elegant, mild-to-medium cigar (Davidoff, milder Cohiba), no milk.
description.hr: Glatka, medena, niske gorčine; oprana, srednje prženje. Skupa je jer je zonirana i rijetka, ne jer je 'najbolja uz cigaru'. Posebna prilika uz elegantnu, srednje blagu cigaru (Davidoff, blaža Cohiba), bez mlijeka.

description.en: Julius Meinl Vienna Line Espresso: 100% arabica, medium roast (their scale 4, medium to dark). The house cites dark chocolate and roasted nuts, full body, sweet and fruity. It is not an Italian robusta blend. It suits a medium Habano; maduro easily overruns the fruit.
description.hr: Julius Meinl Vienna Line Espresso: 100 % arabica, srednje prženje (na njihovoj ljestvici 4, srednje do tamno). Kuća navodi tamnu čokoladu i pržene orašaste, puno tijelo, slatko i voćno. Nije talijanska robusta-mješavina. Ide uz srednju Habano cigaru; maduro lako pregazi voće.

description.en: Lavazza Qualità Oro is 100% arabica from Central and South America, medium roast, intensity 5/10. Official: velvety body, floral and fruity notes. No robusta, so it is softer than Rossa. It keeps a lighter-to-medium Habano; maduro is too heavy.
description.hr: Lavazza Qualità Oro je 100 % arabica iz Srednje i Južne Amerike, srednje pržena, intenzitet 5/10. Službeno: baršunasto tijelo, cvjetne i voćne note. Nema robuste, pa je mekša od Rosse. Uz nju ostaje lakša do srednja Habano cigara; maduro je pretežak.

description.en: Lavazza Qualità Rossa: mainly Brazilian arabica and African robustas, medium roast, intensity 5/10. The house calls it dark-coloured and velvety, with chocolate — full body, no published bean ratio. It works as espresso or moka. It wants a medium-to-full Habano, not Connecticut.
description.hr: Lavazza Qualità Rossa: uglavnom brazilska arabica i afrička robusta, srednje prženje, intenzitet 5/10. Kuća je opisuje kao tamnu, baršunastu, s notom čokolade — punog tijela, bez objavljenog omjera zrna. Radi u espressu i moki. Uz nju ide srednja do puna Habano cigara, ne Connecticut.

description.en: Longer espresso (60–90 ml): more water through the same coffee, often more bitterness and ash because extraction runs too long. A medium cigar still holds; delicate Shade and this ash add up the wrong way.
description.hr: Dulji espresso (60–90 ml): više vode kroz istu kavu, često više gorčine i pepela jer ekstrakcija predugo traje. Srednja cigara još drži; njezni Shade i ovaj pepeo se zbrajaju na krivu stranu.

description.en: Stovetop steam pushes water through the grounds. Stronger than filter, softer than true espresso, with cocoa and mild bitterness. A home ritual with a medium to full cigar, no machine required.
description.hr: Para gura vodu kroz mljevenu kavu na štednjaku. Jača je od filtera, mekša od pravog espressa, s kakaoom i blagom gorčinom. Kućni ritual uz srednju do punu cigaru, bez potrebe za strojem.

description.en: Monsoon process on the Malabar coast: the bean takes up humidity, acidity vanishes, tobacco, spice and cocoa remain. Espresso from this bean behaves like a relative of the cigar. It wants Habano or maduro, not Shade.
description.hr: Monsunska obrada na Malabaru: zrno upija vlagu, kiselost nestaje, ostaju duhan, začin i kakao. Espresso iz ovog zrna ponaša se kao srodnik cigare. Traži Habano ili maduro, ne Shade.

description.en: Bergamot, jasmine, tea-like body; washed, high altitude, light roast. The most delicate cup in the catalogue. Only with the mildest Connecticut. A strong cigar does not 'mismatch' — it wipes this coffee out.
description.hr: Bergamot, jasmin, čajno tijelo; oprana, visoka nadmorska visina, svijetlo prženje. Najdelikatnija šalica u katalogu. Samo uz najblaži Connecticut. Jaka cigara ne 'ne paše' — ona ovu kavu obriše.

description.en: Honey (pulp-natural) process: more sweetness and body than washed, less ferment than natural. Citrus and honey, clean light body. With a light cigar in the morning; peaty and maduro extremes wait for a later act.
description.hr: Honey (pulp natural) obrada: više slatkoće i tijela nego oprana, manje fermenta nego natural. Citrus i med, čisto lagano tijelo. Uz laganu cigaru ujutro; peaty i maduro ekstrem ostaju za drugi čin.

description.en: Shorter extraction, smaller volume, more sweetness than a regular espresso. Bitterness stays, but it is briefer. Small sips with a short, strong cigar; a long Churchill wants a doppio or a french press.
description.hr: Kraća ekstrakcija, manji volumen, veća slatkoća u odnosu na obični espresso. Gorčina ostaje, ali je kraća. Mali gutljaji uz kratku, jaku cigaru; dugi Churchill traži doppio ili french press.

description.en: Segafredo Intermezzo is a dark-roast blend with robusta: high intensity, almond, chocolate, dried fruit and spice. The house points it at espresso and moka. Dense and morning-like; it wants a full Habano or maduro, not Shade.
description.hr: Segafredo Intermezzo je tamno pržena mješavina s robustom: visok intenzitet, badem, čokolada, suho voće i začin. Kuća je namijenjuje espressu i moki. Gusta je i jutarnja; uz nju ide puna Habano ili maduro cigara, ne Shade.

description.en: Giling basah (semi-washed) Sumatra: low acidity, syrupy body, tobacco, wood, earth, leather. The coffee that looks like a Habano cigar in a cup. A natural bridge with earthy smoke; Connecticut has nothing to do.
description.hr: Giling basah (poluprana) Sumatra: niska kiselost, sirupasto tijelo, duhan, drvo, zemlja, koža. Kava koja izgleda kao Habano cigara u šalici. Prirodan most uz zemljani dim; Connecticut ostaje bez posla.

description.en: Very fine grind simmered in a cezve and drunk with the grounds. Thick, muddy, spicy; sugar goes in the pot, not the cup. Traditional with earthy, strong cigars; sweetened, it bridges to maduro.
description.hr: Fino mljevena kava kuha se u džezvi i pije s talogom. Gusta je, mutna i začinska; šećer se dodaje u loncu, ne u šalici. Tradicionalni par zemljanim, jakim cigarama; sa šećerom postaje most prema maduru.

description.en: Washed Yirgacheffe, light roast: jasmine, bergamot, tea-like body. Acidity is high, TDS is low. Only with the mildest Connecticut or Cameroon; a full cigar covers the cup before the third puff.
description.hr: Oprana Yirgacheffe, svijetlo prženje: jasmin, bergamot, čajno tijelo. Kiselost je visoka, TDS nizak. Samo uz najblaži Connecticut ili Cameroon; puna cigara prekrije šalicu prije trećeg dima.

description.en: Kenyan AA from Nyeri: blackcurrant, lemon acidity, a winey finish. Washed process keeps the cup clean. Works as contrast with Cameroon or a shorter Habano; maduro and this acidity fight.
description.hr: Kenijski AA iz Nyerija: crni ribiz, limunska kiselost, vino u aftertasteu. Oprana obrada drži čašu čistom. Radi kao kontrast uz Cameroon ili kraći Habano; maduro i ova kiselost se tuku.

description.en: Phin coffee, often robusta, with condensed milk and ice. Dense, sweet, cold, low acidity. Contrast with a short, spicy cigar in the heat; a long Churchill and this sweetness stick together.
description.hr: Phin kava, često robusta, s kondenziranim mlijekom i ledom. Gust, sladak, hladan profil niske kiselosti. Kontrast uz kratku, začinsku cigaru na vrućini; dugi Churchill i ova slatkoća se lijepe.

line: Vijetnamska ledena kava (cà phê sữa đá)

description.en: Natural (dried) Yemeni mocha: dense body, cocoa, dried fruit, spice, a whiff of smoke. An old trade profile, not specialty fashion. A bridge with maduro and dark notes; a filter-light partner has no business here.
description.hr: Prirodna (sušena) jemenska mocha: gusto tijelo, kakao, suho voće, začin, dašak dima. Stari trgovački profil, ne specialty moda. Most uz maduro i tamne note; filter-light partner ovdje nema što tražiti.

description.en: Aniversario 10 is 1502’s anniversary line with an H-2000 wrapper from Nicaragua — medium body, steady draw and warmer tobacco than mild shade lines. Expect cedar and soft spice without heavy nicotine push. A solid pick when you want an hour and a profile that keeps pace through the middle third.
description.hr: Aniversario 10 je 1502-ova jubilarna linija s H-2000 pokrovom iz Nikaragve — srednje tijelo, uredan draw i topliji duhan nego kod blagih shade linija. Računaj na cedar i blagi začin bez pretjerane snage. Dobra kad želiš sat vremena i profil koji drži ritam kroz srednju trećinu.

description.en: Black Gold is the darkest regular 1502 — rich, chocolate-earthy, with stronger coffee and a longer finish.
description.hr: Black Gold je najtamnija redovna 1502 — bogata, čokoladno-zemljana, uz jaču kavu i dulji finiš.

description.en: Emerald is 1502's most approachable expression — a box-pressed Nicaraguan puro with a closed foot, creamy-woody with gentle spice.
description.hr: Emerald je najpitkiji izraz linije 1502 — nikaragvanski puro s box-pressom i zatvorenom nogom, kremasto-drvenast uz blage začine.

description.en: Nicaragua celebrates terroir: a three-region puro with pronounced spice and earth, medium-full in body.
description.hr: Nicaragua slavi terroir: puro iz tri regije s naglašenim začinima i zemljom, srednje-puno tijelo.

description.en: Ruby brings medium-full body and juicier sweetness than Emerald; the signature box-press and closed foot lock in oils and aroma.
description.hr: Ruby donosi srednje-puno tijelo i sočniju slatkoću od Emeralda; potpisni box-press i zatvorena noga čuvaju ulja i arome.

description.en: 1502 is named for the year Europeans first saw tobacco in Nicaragua. Blue Sapphire is the line's special edition — a Habano wrapper and a balanced cedar-and-spice profile.
description.hr: 1502 je nazvana po godini kad su Europljani prvi put vidjeli duhan u Nikaragvi. Blue Sapphire je posebno izdanje linije — Habano pokrov i uravnotežen, cedrovo-začinski profil.

description.en: Cabinet Selection is Ashton’s classic line for a calmer session — aged habano wrapper, creamy texture and gentle spice rather than push. Cedar and coffee lead the first third, then a touch of leather and nut. A steady medium-bodied pick when you want a clean, predictable draw without fireworks.
description.hr: Cabinet Selection je Ashtonova klasična linija za mirniji stol — zreli habano pokrov, kremasta tekstura i blagi začini umjesto agresivne snage. Profil drži cedar i kavu u prvoj trećini, zatim malo kože i orašastih tonova. Dobar izbor kad želiš srednje tijelo i uredan, predvidiv draw bez iznenađenja.

description.en: Ashton Classic is a mild Dominican line with a Connecticut shade wrapper — creamy texture, low strength and a predictable draw. Ideal as the first cigar at the table or for a guest who does not want a nicotine hit. Pair with a lighter drink; a maduro rum will easily overpower it.
description.hr: Ashton Classic je blaga dominikanska linija s Connecticut shade pokrovom — kremasta tekstura, niska snaga i predvidiv draw. Idealna za prvu cigaru za stolom ili za gosta koji ne želi nikotinski udar. Uz nju biraj lakše piće; maduro rum je lako nadjača.

Draw obično ostaje otvoren; ritam dimova neka bude sporiji u zadnjoj trećini. Uklapa se uz rum s vanilijom, ne uz vrlo suh viski.

description.en: Camacho Connecticut is not the softest shade on the shelf — the Honduran blend keeps a bit more kick than a typical mild Connecticut. The wrapper stays light, but body and spice show earlier. A good pick when you want Connecticut colour with a bit more rhythm in the smoke.
description.hr: Camacho Connecticut nije najmekši shade na polici — honduraški blend drži malo više udarca nego tipični blagi Connecticut. Pokrov ostaje svijetli, ali tijelo i začin izlaze ranije. Dobra kad želiš Connecticut boju uz malo više ritma u dimu.

description.en: Camacho Corojo is the brand’s stronger reference — corojo wrapper, fuller body and spicy warmth that wants a slower pace. Not a quick balcony line: expect earth, pepper and a longer session. Best with a drink that can carry the strength, not a light highball.
description.hr: Camacho Corojo je markina jača referenca — corojo pokrov, punije tijelo i začinska toplina koja traži sporiji dim. Nije linija za brzi balkon: računaj na zemlju, papar i dulju sesiju. Najbolje uz piće koje podnese snagu, ne uz lagani highball.

description.en: Disciple (Diesel) takes a darker maduro wrapper from Nicaragua — medium-full body that wants a slower pace. The profile typically holds darker sweetness, coffee and warmth rather than sharp strength. Choose it when you have time and a drink that can carry more body.

description.en: Esteli Puro (Diesel) takes a natural wrapper from Nicaragua — fuller body and density that wants a calm rhythm. The profile typically holds clean tobacco and soft spice without dramatic jumps. Best with a drink that can carry the strength, not a light highball.

description.en: 107 Nicaragua (La Aurora) takes a Connecticut shade wrapper from Dominikanska Republika — medium body and a steady puff rhythm. The profile typically holds creamy tobacco and soft cedar rather than sharp spice. A solid pick when you want an hour and a profile that holds the middle third.

description.en: Anniversary release marking 85 years of Tabacalera Palma, offered in two wrappers on the same size (Toro 6 x 52): an Ecuadorian Connecticut Shade blended by Jose 'Jochy' Blanco — naturally sweet with a hint of spice — and a US Connecticut Broadleaf blended by his son Jose Manuel — leathery with spice. Both share a Dominican Corojo binder and Criollo '98 / Piloto Cubano filler. A box of 20 holds 10 of each; the run is limited to 2021 boxes.
description.hr: Jubilarno izdanje za 85 godina Tabacalere Palme, u dva pokrova iste veličine (Toro 6 x 52): ekvadorski Connecticut Shade koji je blendao Jose 'Jochy' Blanco — prirodno slatko uz dašak začina — i američki Connecticut Broadleaf, blend njegovog sina Jose Manuela — kožasto uz začine. Oba dijele Corojo vezni list i Criollo '98 / Piloto Cubano punjenje iz Dominikanske Republike. Kutija od 20 nosi 10 i 10; izdanje je ograničeno na 2021 kutiju.

description.en: Gran Puro leans into Punch’s full habano voice — earthy tobacco, cedar and warm spice, with a body that does not rush. This is not a mild Connecticut smoke: expect medium-to-full strength and a longer session. Best when you have an hour and want flavour that keeps an edge through the whole cigar.
description.hr: Gran Puro naglašava puni habano karakter marke Punch — zemljani duhan, cedar i začinska toplina, s tijelom koje ne traži žurbu. Nije lagana Connecticut linija: očekuj srednju do punu snagu i duži dim. Najbolje kad imaš sat vremena i želiš okus koji drži rub kroz cijelu cigaru.

description.en: Cabaiguan (Tatuaje) takes a darker maduro wrapper from Nicaragua — fuller body and density that wants a calm rhythm. The profile typically holds darker sweetness, coffee and warmth rather than sharp strength. Best with a drink that can carry the strength, not a light highball.
description.hr: Cabaiguan (Tatuaje) ide s tamnijim maduro pokrovom iz Nikaragva — punije tijelo i gustoća koja traži miran ritam. Profil tipično drži tamnija slatkoća, kava i toplina umjesto oštre snage. Najbolje uz piće koje podnese snagu, ne uz lagani highball.

description.en: Capa Especial Belle Encre (Tatuaje) takes a natural wrapper from Nicaragua — light body and a predictable draw. The profile typically holds clean tobacco and soft spice without dramatic jumps. A good guest or first-at-the-table pick; do not force it against an overproof rum.
description.hr: Capa Especial Belle Encre (Tatuaje) ide s prirodnim pokrovom iz Nikaragva — lagano tijelo i predvidiv draw. Profil tipično drži čist duhan i blagi začin bez dramatičnih skokova. Dobra za gosta ili prvu cigaru za stolom; ne forsiraš je uz overproof rum.

description.en: Green Chartreuse (55%) — herbaceous, layered, high ABV. One neat sip in a small glass; with a full cigar after the meal.
description.hr: Zelena Chartreuse (55%) — herbaceous, slojevit, visok ABV. Jedan gutljaj neat u maloj čaši; uz punu cigaru nakon jela.

description.en: The classic Milanese fernet — intense mint and a bitter herbal secret. Serve ice-cold; with a cigar after dinner, not before.

description.en: The tall side bottle — vanilla and herbs. Sweeter than Strega; neat works with medium cigars, but it more often lands in cocktails.
description.hr: Visoki bočni flakon — vanilija i bilje. Slatkiji od Strega; neat je moguć uz medium cigaru, ali češće ide u koktele.

description.en: The German herbal liqueur from Wolfenbüttel, on the market since 1935 — 56 herbs, roots and spices, with anise and bitter orange under a pronounced sweetness. Traditionally served ice-cold; alongside a cigar treat it as an after-dinner digestif, not an aperitif.
description.hr: Njemački biljni liker iz Wolfenbüttela, na tržištu od 1935. — 56 biljaka, korijena i začina, s anisom i gorkom narančom ispod izražene slatkoće. Tradicionalno se pije ledeno hladan, a uz cigaru ga treba shvatiti kao digestiv nakon jela, ne kao aperitiv.

description.en: Amaro from the Nonino family — grappa base with herbal distillate. Finer than mass-market amari; with a cigar as an after-dinner digestif.
